```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

necessary libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(openxlsx)
```

load in gis master file data (so far)
```{r}
gismaster3 = read.csv("mastergis3.csv", header = TRUE, colClasses = c(ZIP_code_GIS = "character"))
uniques2 = read.csv("uniquewnums.csv")
```

we create a new column citystatezip, that shows each grants city, state, and zip in one string
```{r}
gismaster3$citystate = paste(gismaster3$city_GIS, gismaster3$state_GIS, sep = ", ")
gismaster3$citystatezip = paste(gismaster3$citystate, gismaster3$ZIP_code_GIS, sep = ", ")
```

```{r}
locations_long = uniques2 %>%
  separate_rows(grant_number, sep = ",\\s*")
```

```{r}
gismaster3 <- gismaster3 %>%
  left_join(
    locations_long %>%
      select(grant_number, Latitude, Longitude),
    by = "grant_number"
  )
```
our dataframe now has the content we need, so we download and observe results in sheets
```{r}
write.xlsx(gismaster3, "biggismaster.xlsx")
getwd()
```
